Savor the uniqueness of this well-kept residence! Ideal offerings such as two-car garage, fencing and dual vanities. 3 bedrooms, 2 baths. Dining al fresco is just one of the many possibilities using the delightful covered patio. You will also enjoy these additional features: wood flooring and ceiling fans. Reap the immediate rewards of sanctuary, comfort and equity.

2 full bath
